data_fields.name: aggression
data_fields.donor_constant: per tier: COMPLIANT -4; FRIENDLY 1..7; AGGRESSIVE 1..10; HOSTILE 4..10; SAVAGE 10 (inclusive random roll at init)

data_fields.name: power_band_thresholds
data_fields.donor_constant: ratio >=7 gives 11; >=1 gives trunc(2*(ratio-1)); >=0.5 gives -1; >=0.333 gives -2; else -3

data_fields.name: sympathy_points
data_fields.donor_constant: +1 if any similar unit; +1 if similar units x2 > total units

data_fields.name: free_join_test
data_fields.donor_constant: diplomacy + sympathy + 1 >= aggression (and setting or COMPLIANT, and not gold-only)

data_fields.name: gold_join_test
data_fields.donor_constant: diplomacy x 2 + sympathy + 1 >= aggression; price = recruit cost x first-stack count

data_fields.name: hero_value_skill_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.05 per attack and per defence point; hero value = sqrt((1+0.05a)(1+0.05d)) x army strength

best_idea: Decide what a group does on contact (engage, back off, or join) from one banded power ratio plus a per-group aggression threshold, so each outcome is one testable state change.
decision_why: The contact decision and the flee-without-pursue outcome fit engage-as-state-change in src/fight; the visit dialogs and the gold recruit offer are adventure-map features that do not fit a real-time zone, so take the shape only.
acceptance: A server test asserts the decision table for fixed inputs (band factor, sympathy, diplomacy cap 3, FIGHT/FLEE/JOIN); in play a group the hero outmatches 7x never fights, and a group that outmatches the hero (hero value under a third of the group's value) fights when its aggression is 4 or more.
